purpose: A picture of a tanuki statue to try the image-to-3D tool on (scripts/props/image_to_3d.py): one object, whole, front on, level, on a plain ground. Not an ad, and not for the world as a picture.

items.style: product photograph for a catalogue, soft even studio lighting, sharp focus
items.subject: a single glazed ceramic tanuki statue of the kind that stands outside Japanese restaurants, standing upright, round belly, straw hat on its back, a sake flask in one paw, big friendly eyes, the whole figure in frame from hat to feet, seen straight on from the front at eye level
items.composition: centred, isolated on a plain light grey seamless background, no other objects, no ground shadow
items.notes: Input for image-to-3D. The back will be invented by the model.
